2.The Board of Directors of the Bank at its Meeting held on January 25, 2025 approved the re-appointment of Mr. Sandeep Batra (DIN:03620913) as Executive Director of the Bank for a period of two years from December 23, 2025 to December 22, 2027, subject to the approval of Reserve Bank of India, shareholders, and such other approvals as may be required. The shareholders at the Annual General Meeting held on August 30, 2025 , approved the re-appointment of Mr. Sandeep Batra for the aforementioned tenure.

4. The Board of Directors of the Bank at its Meeting held on October 18, 2025 approved the appointed of Ms. Vijayalakshmi Iyer (DIN: 05242960) as an Additional (Independent) Director of the Bank for a term commencing from December 1, 2025 to May 31, 2030, subject to the approval of shareholders which is being sought by way of Postal Ballot.
5. The Board of Directors of the Bank had, at its meeting held on January 17, 2026, unanimously approved the re-appointment of Mr. Sandeep Bakhshi (DIN: 00109206) as Managing Director & CEO of the Bank for a further period of two years with effect from October 4, 2026 to October 3, 2028, subject to approval of Reserve Bank of India, shareholders, and such other approvals as may be required.
6.
